name: Sneaky Familiar
body:
Your familiar has learned to imitate your stealthy attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane bond (familiar) class feature, sneak attack +2d6

Benefit: Your familiar gains a +2 bonus to Stealth checks and gains the sneak attack class feature at 1 fewer dice than you possess. (e.g., if you have sneak attack +4d6, your familiar has sneak attack +3d6.)
